# DSH Selection Comments
简体中文
Comment on conversation passages in DeepSeek Harness Web/Desktop, without filling your draft with co
conversation passages in DeepSeek Harness Web/Desktop, without filling your draft with copied text.
> Public synthetic demo: real plugin + React with sample transcript/input adapters, not a live DSH s
c synthetic demo: real plugin + React with sample transcript/input adapters, not a live DSH session.
## Features

- Select text to add a comment, with a numbered badge anchored beside the passage.
- **0.3.3:** Keep
selection actions working in DSH's grouped/nested process flows while isolating separate conversati

on panes.
- Keep quote + comment in one compact draft reference; expand both when submitting.
- **0.
3.2:** Read sent quotes/comments as compact, expandable cards instead of raw XML tags, including com

patible message history.
- Edit, delete, or re-add a comment from its badge/reference; review everyt

hing in **All comments**.
- Keep the composer uncluttered: no permanent comments toolbar or extra fo

comments**.
- Keep the composer uncluttered: no permanent comments toolbar or extra footer counter.
## Install
For DSH Web or Windows Desktop; see the compatibility matrix for the API baseline and tested scope.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Use the official DSH CLI supplied with your target installation; replace `desktop` with your intende
d profile. The client bundle is included—no build required.
## Use in four steps

1. Select a passage in the conversation and click **注释 / Comment**.
2. Write your note and choose **

Add comment**, or press `Ctrl/⌘+Enter`.
3. Click a numbered badge or draft reference to edit, delete

, re-add, or open **All comments**.
4. Submit normally in DSH: references expand to the original quo
te and your note, not just a number.
## After sending
*Browser capture of production plugin components with public sample data, not a private session or m
odel-delivery test.*
On compatible hosts, sent messages and compatible history show numbered quotation/comment cards. **E
xpand** reads the full content; queue previews stay compact. Cards are snapshots of the sent text—ed
iting/deleting an unsent annotation does not change them. Model context and message Copy/Edit retain
the full original text. Hosts without the official user-text extension seam show the original XML i
nstead; see details and limits.
Both filled comment actions use the skin's matched primary fill/foreground/hover tokens, including s
kins with transparent base surfaces.
## Language
**Simplified Chinese is the default**, even with an English browser or DSH. Choose **English** or **
Follow DSH** in the comment dialog's language selector; `Esc` closes the dialog.
## Review your comments
**All comments** shows quotes, notes, and draft status. **Delete all comments** removes this session
's comments, draft references, and plugin tab cache.
## Recovery
Comments can recover after refresh in the **same browser tab** via `sessionStorage`; this is not cro
ss-tab/cloud sync or secure erasure—see privacy and limits.
